rule.name: DelimitedLookupKey
rule.message: This map or set key joins two runtime strings with a delimiter, so the pairs "a-b" and "c", and "a" and "b-c", produce the same key: one entry overwrites or answers for another. Key it with a record, List.of(a, b) or a nested map, or encode the parts so the delimiter cannot appear in them. A number, an enum, an id that cannot hold the delimiter and a literal are fine.
